answer: Operator-lien ingress throttling. The economy clusters wallets by control-plane attestations (billing keys, CI signers, ASN/runtime fingerprints), then runs sparse canary sparrow probes to detect coordinated activity. On correlation, the operator—not wallets—receives an inlet lien: API ingress is rate-limited and payouts queue at a wharf escrow pending audit. Attacker cost: every sybil under that operator loses throughput and settlement speed; clearing requires fresh control-plane credentials, audit time, and liquidity delay, making mass wallets uneconomic.
